items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Kirby was looking for someone to play Maxine's music... I played the set with Maxine and it went over pretty big, you know. So Kirby, he hired me on the spot right then.

ctx.x: Now, what happened there? How did that lead to you getting the job? Was Pete leaving anyway, or what happened?

Well, that I don't know. I don't know whether Pete was leaving or not. But I do know that Kirby was looking for someone to play Maxine's music, and all due respect to everybody, when they were recording Maxine they had to get an outside alto player to play the music. So I suppose when I happened on the scene that night, I suppose -- I suppose -- and I sat in, I suppose it was just what he was
looking for. And so my entrance into the band you might say was to play Maxine's music. And whatever happened after that was just, you know, frosting on the cake.

items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Kirby took care of mostly of the band business but it was actually the Charlie Shavers and Billy Kyle who were responsible for the musical ideas. And of course he had a very good group of musicians with him, Russell Procope, Buster Bailey, Charlie, Billy Kyle.

ctx.x: So it's interesting if that would also be shown to be a Kirby original.

Well, anything with Charlie Shavers and Buster Bailey and Russell Procope on that particular album, they were originals, because they were written especially when we had the show, Flow Gently Sweet Rhythm.
